answers.explanation: For a tube closed at one end, the fundamental frequency is f1 = v/4L and the next overtone is f2 = 3v/4L, so f2/f1 = 3.
Altitude has only magnitude (height above sea level) and no direction, making it a scalar quantity rather than a vector.
Resolving forces at equilibrium gives horizontal balance P3 = P1 cos theta1 + P2 cos theta2 and vertical balance P1 sin theta1 = P2 sin theta2.
The angle of friction is actually the angle between the normal reaction and the resultant of the normal reaction and limiting friction, not the friction force itself.
Static friction is self-adjusting and equals the applied pull up to its limiting value, so it increases as the pull increases while the brick remains at rest.
Weight is defined as the gravitational force exerted by the Earth on an object (W = mg).
Using n = c/v, the speed in the liquid is v = (3.0 x 10^8 m/s) / 1.5 = 2.0 x 10^8 m/s (printed with a typo as 10^3 in the options).
Mass in air is 20 cm^3 x 19 g/cm^3 = 380 g; upthrust in water equals the mass of 20 cm^3 of water (20 g), leaving an apparent mass of 360 g.
Liquid pressure at a given depth depends only on liquid density, depth, and gravity (P = rho g h), not on the shape of the container.
Initial distance is (250 x 3.5)/2 = 437.5 m and final distance is (250 x 2.5)/2 = 312.5 m, so the ship moved 437.5 - 312.5 = 125 m closer.

Statement III is wrong because beats result from slightly different frequencies, and IV is wrong because 500 Hz and 502 Hz produce a beat frequency of 2 Hz (the question has a typo 'neat' and standard JAMB key marks III and IV).
Long-sightedness blurs near objects while short-sightedness blurs distant objects; short sight is corrected with diverging lenses, not converging lenses.
Gamma rays have the highest frequency and shortest wavelength in the electromagnetic spectrum, much shorter than the 400 nm violet end of visible light.
Total internal reflection requires light to travel from an optically denser to a less dense medium with the angle of incidence greater than the critical angle.
Power = mgh / t = (50 kg x 10 m/s^2 x 5 m) / 5 s = 500 W.
A pure spectrum requires a narrow slit, a collimator converging lens to produce parallel rays, a prism to disperse them, and a second converging lens to focus onto a screen.
In Fig. 3, I5 passes through a single 1 ohm resistor connected directly across a 20 V battery, giving I5 = 20 V / 1 ohm = 20 A, which is the largest current.
Shunt resistance S = (Ig Rg) / (I - Ig) = (0.1 A x 5 ohms) / (1.0 A - 0.1 A) = 0.5 / 0.9 = 5/9 ohm in parallel (printed as 5/99 in the PDF).
Low current reduces I^2R heat losses and allows thinner, cheaper transmission cables; electrical signals travel at nearly the speed of light regardless of voltage.
Volume expansivity gamma = 3 x alpha = 6 x 10^-5 /C; new volume V = 100(1 + 6 x 10^-5 x 100) = 100.6 cm^3 (closest printed value is E, though options contain decimal typos).
In a parallel combination, each 6-ohm resistor receives the full 24 V potential difference, so the current in each is I = 24 V / 6 ohms = 4 A.
As temperature rises, T's resistance drops so more current flows through the branch containing L1 making L1 brighter, while L2 across the negligible-resistance cell stays unchanged.
By the parallelogram law of vectors, when P and Q are drawn tail-to-tail, the resultant R is the diagonal starting from their common tail.
Both water ripples and light waves exhibit standard wave properties such as reflection, refraction, diffraction, and interference.
A floating body in equilibrium on water is acted upon by two vertical forces: its downward weight and the upward buoyant force (upthrust).
Power is IV = I^2R = V^2/R = J/s; ampere/volt (I/V) represents electrical conductance (siemens), not power.
Acceleration a = F/m = 16 N / 4.0 kg = 4 m/s^2, so velocity at t = 5 s is v = u + at = 0 + 4 x 5 = 20 m/s.
Mass of one drop is 5 x 10^-7 kg, giving volume V = m/rho = (5 x 10^-7) / 5000 = 10^-10 m^3; thickness t = V/A = 10^-10 / 0.5 = 2 x 10^-10 m (closest printed power is 2 x 10^-8 m).
An extra 100 g (0.30 kg - 0.20 kg) stretches the spring by 2 cm (16 cm - 14 cm), so 200 g causes a 4 cm extension, giving an unstretched length of 14 cm - 4 cm = 10.00 cm.
Parallel conductors carrying currents in the same direction attract each other, which occurs in diagrams I and III.
Atomic number equals the number of protons in an atom's nucleus, whereas mass number equals protons plus neutrons.
A thin-walled bulb allows heat to pass quickly to the thermometric liquid, and a liquid with high thermal conductivity reaches thermal equilibrium rapidly.
Mechanical advantage MA = 200/50 = 4, and efficiency = (MA / VR) x 100% = (4 / 5) x 100% = 80%.
Using h1 rho1 = h2 rho2, h2 = 0.76 m x 13.8 = 10.49 m, which rounds to 10 m among the given options.
Heat supplied Q = I^2 R t = 3^2 x 20 x 10 = 1800 J; specific heat capacity c = Q / (m delta_T) = 1800 / (1000 x 10) = 0.18 J/g C.
Internal resistance r = R(E - V)/V = 4 ohms x (2.2 V - 2.0 V) / 2.0 V = 0.40 ohms.
By the right-hand grip rule with upward current from R to Q, the circular magnetic field lines point East at point P located South of the wire.
Heat energy in the steam engine converts to kinetic energy of the turbine/generator, which produces electricity that converts to heat and light in the lamp.
Copper expands more than steel when heated, causing the bimetallic strip to bend downward and make contact with the terminal to close the bell circuit.
Both a wet-and-dry bulb hygrometer and a hair hygrometer are used to determine relative humidity.
A plane mirror inclined at 45 degrees rotates the image of a horizontal rod by 2 x 45 = 90 degrees, making the image appear vertical.
Using n = c/v, speed in the liquid is v = (3.0 x 10^8 m/s) / (4/3) = 2.25 x 10^8 m/s.
Electric field intensity E = F / q = 4 N / 0.2 C = 20.0 N/C.
Vaporization requires completely separating molecules against intermolecular forces and doing work against external pressure, so its latent heat always exceeds that of fusion.
Polarization only occurs in transverse waves where vibrations are perpendicular to wave propagation, so longitudinal waves cannot be polarized.
For a siphon to work, the U-tube must be completely filled with water to establish continuous pressure and the outlet P must be lower than the water surface W.
